finalText:
Migrated 11 files from `db.query` to `db.execute({ sql, params })`.

One holdout left: `vendor\legacy-orm\adapter.js`. It's marked "vendored, replaced wholesale on every upgrade" so I left it untouched.

Since `db.query` still exists in `lib/db.js` for that vendor shim, nothing breaks. Worth flagging to whoever owns the legacy-orm upgrade.
